notes.TWN: 台灣不在世界銀行（WHO）資料庫中，改用衛生福利部的資料：醫院的每萬人口病床數除以 10（不含診所的病床），含急診觀察床、血液透析床等特殊病床，可能比其他國家的算法多；2001–2014 年只有 2005、2010 年

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan is not in the World Bank (WHO) database; Ministry of Health and Welfare data used instead: hospital beds per 10,000 people divided by 10 (excluding beds in clinics), including special beds such as emergency observation and haemodialysis beds, so possibly more than other countries count; for 2001–2014 only 2005 and 2010 are available
